Sandbox_LayeredPlacement_LayeredPlace: Allow lights over furniture and stacked decor
Sandbox_LayeredPlacement_LayeredPlace_to: Allow players to stack posters and wall decor on the same wall and place ceiling lights over furniture. Floor furniture remains unchanged.
Sandbox_LayeredPlacement_FloatingPlace: Allow placement on railings and catwalks
Sandbox_LayeredPlacement_FloatingPlace_t: Allow players to place and pick up hanging lights and other high decor on railings, posts, catwalk edges, and other locations without a solid wall or floor.
Sandbox_LayeredPlacement_MeshFloorAim_to: Allow players upstairs to aim Place and Pickup at their current floor when the cursor falls through a grated floor to the level below.
Sandbox_LayeredPlacement_CatwalkReach_to: Allow Place and Pickup to finish when a player is already near a catwalk or railing tile but normal pathing cannot reach it.
Sandbox_LayeredPlacement_LightInteract: Easier railing light controls (disabled - in development)
Sandbox_LayeredPlacement_LightInteract_t: Turned off in this version and ignored even if you enable it. Clicking near a lamp could toggle a light you were not aiming at, so lights use the normal controls for now. This needs more development and will return in a later update. Placing lights on railings is unaffected.
